description: This file defines a PHP class 'UpdateThemeHooks' that provides theme hook implementations and preprocessing functions for the Drupal update module, including rendering update status, version info, and error messages.

classes.name: UpdateThemeHooks
classes.description: A class providing theme hook implementations and preprocessing functions for the Drupal update module, including rendering update status, version info, and error messages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: state, date formatter, module handler, current user, redirect destination.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for various update-related templates.

methods.name: preprocessUpdateLastCheck
methods.description: Prepares variables for the last update check time template, including formatted time difference and a manual check link.

methods.name: preprocessUpdateReport
methods.description: Prepares variables for the update report, including project status tables and no data message.

methods.name: preprocessUpdateVersion
methods.description: Prepares variables for displaying update version information and core compatibility details.

methods.name: preprocessUpdateProjectStatus
methods.description: Prepares variables for project status display, including version info, status labels, icons, and links.

methods.name: preprocessUpdateFetchErrorMessage
methods.description: Prepares error message variables for update fetch failures, including links to logs.
